note: Names, descriptions and grades are the ones shown on the console trophy list (PS5 / Xbox), as compiled from the independent guides below. No official Rockstar, Sony or Microsoft page publishes the list as a web page; the guides below cross-check each other and agree on all 55 names and grades. One disagreement is noted: Push Square's page labels Maximum Withdrawal Bronze, while GTA Vibes, GTA Scoop, KeenGamer and the kit data all list it Silver, so this guide lists it Silver.

roadmap.title: Play the story — about 60 to 80 hours
steps: Play through all five chapters. The 12 story trophies unlock as you finish missions and chapters; none of them can be missed.

Meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1. It is one of the 18 meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude, the only trophy anyone flags as possibly missable, and that spot may only be available in Chapter 1.
Take stranger missions as they appear. Eight stranger strands feed both the Strangers & Freaks trophy and 100% completion.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you go: Whip It Good (100 vehicles) and Fair Game build up naturally this way.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. There is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back.
Never use a cheat on your platinum save. Cheats disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: Work the 100% checklist — about 100 hours
steps: After the final mission the 100% Completion checklist opens (Touch Pad, then Progress). A Long Road, the gold trophy, is reaching 100% on it.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges (50 are enough for One Last Thing, 70 for 100%).
Complete 300 stunts for 100% (250 are enough for Cunning Stunts).
Finish 15 of the 18 collectible card sets for 100% (3 sets are enough for Don't Touch My Deck).
Finish the 8 stranger mission strands, explore all of Leonida, and clear the remaining checklist items.

roadmap.title: Clean up — about 10 hours
steps: Earn gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges for The Shootist.
Scan 100 WAiNK locations, rob the 5 bank vaults, and finish any crime or activity trophies left over.
Check each hidden trophy's guide below; five of them are still unsolved by every published guide as of 2026-11-21, so expect their methods to be confirmed by the community after launch week.
When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! follows at once.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. There are no online trophies and no DLC trophies, so everything is earned in single-player. Expect around 200 hours: the long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), not the story.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, Jason's opening mission. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to prepare for; just play the mission through to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, meditate at Jason's house: it is one of the 18 meditation spots, and the guides flag it as the one spot that may only exist in Chapter 1. That protects Positive Mental Attitude, the only trophy with a missable warning.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies unlock automatically as the chapters end, so there is no separate task here. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you want to replay any of it later: there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks on its own when the chapter ends. Use the chapter to keep working on the long grinds — stunts, WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery all count from the start.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. One thing worth doing in this chapter: bank vaults open through an optional Chapter 4 mission, and five vault robberies are needed for Maximum Withdrawal, so start the vault jobs once they unlock rather than leaving all five for after the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold story trophy and the last chapter trophy. Free roam stays open after the credits, so finishing the story loses you nothing: everything else on the list can still be earned afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the campaign, so just keep playing the story in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission like the others in this group: play the campaign in order and the trophy follows the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another campaign trophy: it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra condition attached.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the campaign in order and this pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is a campaign trophy, so it unlocks when the mission ends. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can takes place, so the area is worth remembering for later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies: it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). Progress made earlier still counts. You do not need literally everything in the game — about 60% of the content by one guide's estimate — but you do need almost everything on the checklist itself: 70 of the 80 Challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, 8 stranger strands, and the rest of the checklist items. This is the hardest and longest trophy on the list, and it drives most of the roughly 200-hour platinum estimate.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of the 397 in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between tall buildings, and 25 base jumps. Any mix counts, so pick the kinds you find easiest and repeat them across Leonida. Track them at Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Note that 100% completion asks for 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types in the game at least once. You only need to try them, not win or finish them, so this is one of the quickest trophies: work through the activities list on the map (Touch Pad, then Activities) and sample one of each. Most players earn it naturally while exploring.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. There are two range locations: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some are locked until you meet other conditions, which the map shows. Work through them one range at a time and check progress at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find the locations at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win; you need a win at every location, not just a finish.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race twenty times does not count: each win has to be at a different race location. Race locations appear as you explore Leonida; track them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, and a car's Rating matters — improve it with upgrades from Mod Shops if your own car is losing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg: fish in the marked area on your map until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod; if you do not own one, there are boats in the area you can take. The challenge is the catch itself, so keep fishing the marked spot rather than wandering.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in the world, start a game and play it through to the end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find easiest and finish a full run of it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Andy's stranger missions, through to his final one. Stranger missions appear as you explore; follow Andy's strand to its end. Finishing it also counts towards Strangers & Freaks, which needs 8 completed stranger strands.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Kenton's stranger missions, ending with the mission Maritime Disputes. Work through Kenton's strand as it appears and finish that last mission to pop the trophy. It also counts towards Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Billy's stranger missions, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes. Follow Billy's strand to its end; the trophy pops when that final mission completes, and it counts towards Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named stranger trophies on this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are five of them, so finish those strands and find three more. Not every side questline counts, and the guides were still confirming exactly which strands qualify as of launch week, so check the strand counter as you go. All of it can be done after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Randy's stranger missions, through to his final one. Randy's strand involves a vehicle wish list, and the guides point to a list of Randy's Wish List vehicle locations to help you progress it. Finish the strand and the trophy pops; it counts towards Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Tyrone's stranger missions, ending with the mission Spin On This. Tyrone's strand involves Kitty Litter Lab locations, which the guides list separately to help you progress. Finish the final mission and the trophy pops; it counts towards Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The only trophy flagged as possibly missable. One meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it may only be available during Chapter 1. Meditate there before you finish Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. A meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played, so stay at the spot until it finishes. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, and find discovered spots at Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida. The warning: one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and the guides flag it as the one spot that may only be available then. Meditate there the first chance you get in Chapter 1 and you have nothing to worry about. Whether that spot actually counts is still unconfirmed, so treat it as required to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a stranger strand: find Bret, take his hunting work, and track down the unique animal he asks for. Study animals as you travel anyway — the hunting and tracking skills carry over to the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are found across Leonida; track them at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count towards your progress, so selling a duplicate is safe. If you are chasing A Long Road you need 15 sets, so keep collecting well past the 3 this trophy asks for.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open the phone). Scannable spots are landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23), plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so you do not need every one. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. Scan anything that looks like a landmark as you travel and the count builds up on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges in the game. Challenges are in-game feats across eight categories of 10 — combat, vehicles and the rest — and they are all available from the start. View them at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges, and pick off the easy ones first. Note that 100% completion asks for 70, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Do it with your partner present — a solo escape does not count. Use the usual escape tools: break line of sight, get out of the search area, swap vehicles, and use alleys and cover until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them in quick succession, and keep the heat on: if the wanted level drops to zero before the third robbery, the chain breaks and you start again. Have a fast getaway car parked nearby.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it, so this builds up naturally through the story — most players earn it without trying. Track the ones you have found at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Vehicles. If you are short near the end, drive through busy areas and parking lots and hop into anything new.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up before the fight: raise your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies in one place, trigger Combat Focus, and land five takedowns before it runs out. If you run dry, reload the attempt rather than the whole mission.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane from VCIA and take off without going through the normal channels. Get onto the airfield, grab a plane, and get airborne. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so be ready to fly clear of the airport quickly.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and survive the heat that follows. The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, and the guides agree the unlock is stealing one. Military vehicles are heavily guarded, so plan the approach, grab the tank, and drive it somewhere the army cannot easily follow.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job: get in, take the goods and get out before anyone spots you or raises the alarm. Move quietly, watch the staff and cameras, and leave before the store can call it in. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — slip away and try the store again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of the 8 vaults in the game. Vault jobs open through an optional Chapter 4 mission, and each one brings a 4-star wanted level, so bring a plan and a fast car. Time a job with an armored truck delivery to get the vault open. Five successful vault escapes is the count — you do not need all eight.
trophies.note: Push Square's page labels this trophy Bronze; GTA Vibes, GTA Scoop, KeenGamer and the kit data list it Silver. This guide follows the majority.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. Have a getaway vehicle ready before you start — the escape is the part that counts.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every region of the map. Drive, fly and sail through the areas you have not seen yet; the map fills in as you go. If a corner stays dark, take a plane or boat out to it. This finishes naturally for most players during the story and the side content, but check the map for unexplored patches near the end.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find the gangs' operations around the map, hit one per gang, and get away clean. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so you do not repeat one and miss another.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The guides report the spot as the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach: go there, order a cocktail and take in the view until the trophy pops. This method is reported by the guides, not yet confirmed by every source, so if it does not pop at the rooftop bar, try the other beachfront bars on Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a car, in classic style — the description is a nod to the series' old showroom-smash moments. Drive a car into a vehicle showroom and power straight out through the glass. This is the reported reading of the description; the exact showroom and trigger were still unconfirmed as of 2026-11-21, so if one showroom does not work, try another.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The guides report the unlock as stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling: visit the alley, take the three valuables, and leave with them. That method is reported, not confirmed by every source, so treat it as the best current lead rather than a certainty.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. The guides read the description — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — as a gym trophy for the pair: train both characters' strength to the maximum. Work out regularly with each of them until their strength is maxed. This is the guides' reading of the hidden description, reported rather than confirmed by every source.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 Criminal Profile actions. The guides read the description as a long count of criminal-profile actions: keep doing the small criminal acts the profile tracks — robberies, thefts and the like — and the count builds up across the whole playthrough. Check the Criminal Profile in the game to see your progress. This is the guides' reading of the hidden description, reported rather than confirmed by every source.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed how to unlock this one yet. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests failing something once and succeeding on the second try, but that is only a guess from the words, and no published guide states a method as of 2026-11-21. Do not chase a specific trick for it; play normally and watch for community confirmations after launch week. This guide will not invent a method where none is published.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed how to unlock this one yet. The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points at something strange or unexpected in the world, but no published guide states a method as of 2026-11-21. It is most likely tied to an odd event or encounter somewhere in Leonida. Play normally, explore odd corners of the map, and watch for community confirmations after launch week rather than chasing an invented method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock targets down. One guide describes it as performing the required melee drive-by elimination, with the precise method still being confirmed. Try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon against a group on foot; the exact target count is not yet published, so treat the first attempts as experiments and check the trophy after each one.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to wash them into clean cash. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so keep laundering every marked bill you earn instead of letting them pile up. Five bank vaults and a string of robberies will get you most of the way there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in the game. Any shop spending counts, and the total is cumulative. Find shops on the map (Touch Pad, then Style). You will spend much of it naturally on clothes, food and gear, and the garage purchases for Little Boxes cost $160,000 on their own — those may count too, but do not rely on it: keep buying what you need and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties, for $160,000 in total. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (press Up, then the app). The eight are: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800). Each garage adds one vehicle storage slot, and registered vehicles can then be called with Scooter Bros.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros delivers your registered, fully repaired vehicles to your location for a small fee. Register a vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or a Mod Shop, as long as you have an empty parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. You need 10 different vehicles, and buying more garages (see Little Boxes) gives you more parking spots to hold them.
